agentUpdateInstructions: Back up the matching source, D1 database, R2 bucket and private settings (.dev.vars, or .rer/hosted.env and the deploy receipt for a hosted copy) and exercise a restored copy. Stop rer dev, run git pull --ff-only to v0.5.0, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then rer setup locally or rer deploy --environment <name> hosted: both apply the 25 new migrations (0081_imported_engagement.sql through 0106_contact_bulk_actions.sql) in filename order. @runeditrun/rer moves from 0.2.85 to 0.2.134. MAIL_PROVIDER=none is new: it needs no sender or key, refuses every send as mail_off, and the owner signs in with rer signin; an existing mail configuration is unchanged.
publicReleaseNotes: Mango 0.5.0 brings the release up to Run Edit Run 0.2.134 and lets a Business run Mango with mail off: MAIL_PROVIDER=none needs no sender or key, every send is refused as mail_off, and the owner signs in with rer signin. Since 0.4.0 it adds a paid tier on the owner's own Stripe account, WooCommerce and review/loyalty connections, imported engagement and incumbent move-in (consent attestations, restrictions, images), attribution policy, saved report schedules, analytics tagging, opt-in modes per capture point, reusable email blocks, visual flow drafts, typed contact properties and contact bulk actions, and the Decision Desk as the owner's first screen. Migrations: 0081_imported_engagement.sql, 0082_campaign_attribution_policy.sql, 0083_failed_operations.sql, 0084_paid_tier.sql, 0085_woocommerce_connection.sql, 0086_woocommerce_plugin_flows.sql, 0087_paid_state_authority.sql, 0089_signup_capacity.sql, 0090_analytics_tagging.sql, 0091_capture_opt_in_modes.sql, 0092_link_host_sources.sql, 0093_recipient_unsubscribe_method.sql, 0094_sender_renewal_deliveries.sql, 0095_saved_report_schedules.sql, 0096_review_loyalty_adapters.sql, 0097_sending_connection.sql, 0098_incumbent_attestations.sql, 0099_flow_draft_revisions.sql, 0100_incumbent_review_counts.sql, 0101_reusable_email_blocks.sql, 0102_incumbent_images.sql, 0103_contact_property_definitions.sql, 0104_sending_event_silence.sql, 0105_incumbent_restrictions.sql, 0106_contact_bulk_actions.sql.
